name: Finkbine Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Gold. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: course closed for renovation through spring 2027, and the post-renovation routing will differ from OSM/2021 imagery

1: Page uses golfify Black 415 and walks the tee back 37 yds off the OSM back box onto the grass/cart area behind it.
3: Current card Black 418 = OSM hole-line start (417). Page Black sits on a forward box at 394 (old golfify card); Gold 394 vs page 368. Club pick computed from ~24 yds too far forward.
9: Black on the back OSM box (461 measured); current card 428, golfify 449. Measured tee-to-green fits a box ~33 yds behind the card tee; minor for the pick (Driver).
10: Golfify 449 (duplicate of 9/18, a card typo); page walked the tee 43 yds back past the OSM line start into rough by the road. Current card Black 410 = OSM hole-line start (408).
12: Black marker on a lidar pad 21 yds right of the hole line (not an OSM box). Current card Black 374 = straight tee-to-green from the OSM line start (373). Tee should be on the OSM hole-line start box.
13: Golfify 199; page walked back 24 yds behind the OSM line start onto no tee. Current card Black 182 matches the OSM back box (177); Gold 160.
